title: Apportionment of input tax credit on inputs, input services and capital goods, and reversal of common credit attributable to exempt or non-business supplies

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Rule 42 amended by Notification No. 16/2019-CT (dated 29-03-2019) for residential real estate project reporting; annual true-up deadline amended from 30 September to 30 November by Finance Act, 2022 read with Notification No. 18/2022-CT; mandatory reporting in GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(1) enforced by Circular No. 170/02/2022-GST.

plainTextSummary: Under Section 17(1) and 17(2) of the CGST Act read with Rules 42 and 43, input tax credit (ITC) must be attributed between business vs non-business purposes, and taxable supplies (including zero-rated exports) vs exempt supplies. Under Rule 42 (Inputs and Input Services), total ITC (T) is segregated by identifying specific ineligible credit: T1 (non-business), T2 (exempt supplies), and T3 (blocked u/s 17(5)). The balance C1 = T - (T1 + T2 + T3) is credited to the electronic ledger. Specific eligible credit T4 (taxable/exports) is deducted to yield Common Credit C2 = C1 - T4. Ineligible common credit is then apportioned monthly: D1 = (E/F) * C2 (exempt turnover ratio) and D2 = 5% of C2 (non-business use), with D1 + D2 reversed in GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(1). Under Rule 42(2), an annual true-up must be performed on or before 30th November following the end of the financial year. If annual reversal exceeds monthly reversals, the shortfall must be paid with 18% interest under Section 50(1) from 1st April of the succeeding financial year. If monthly reversals exceed annual reversal, the excess may be reclaimed as ITC before 30th November. Under Rule 43 (Capital Goods), common capital goods have a statutory deemed useful life of 60 months. Monthly credit is sliced as Tm = Tc / 60, and monthly exempt reversal Te = (E/F) * Tr is added to output tax liability.

requiredDocumentChecklist: Monthly and Annual GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B returns establishing aggregate taxable turnover (F) and exempt turnover (E)
Inward Purchase Register with specific identification flags (T1 non-business, T2 exempt, T3 blocked u/s 17(5), T4 taxable)
Capital Asset Register documenting capital goods purchase dates, invoice values, and 60-month useful life tracking
Monthly GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(1) disclosure vouchers verifying provisional reversals (D1 + D2 and Te)
Annual Rule 42/43 true-up working papers and Section 50(1) interest calculation schedules
